# Geographic & environmental features — method report

*Generated by `pipeline.geographic.features` on 2026-10-05T14:42:32+00:00. Do not edit by hand.*


Per-cell geographic/environmental Feature_Table on the common analysis grid (Sprint 1 task S1-06). One row per grid `cell_id`; terrain statistics, dominant land use, protected-area constraint, TRI, and a per-cell confidence flag.

## Method

### Aggregation statistic per variable

| Variable | Source raster | Statistic | Units |
|---|---|---|---|
| `elevation_m` | Elevation_Raster (SRTM GL3, NSW) | mean of valid pixels | metres AMSL |
| `slope_deg` | Slope_Raster (Horn slope, NSW) | mean of valid pixels | degrees |
| `tri` | TRI (Riley, Glen-Innes sub-window) | mean of valid pixels | metres |

**Partial-cell boundary rule.** Cell-centre inclusion: a raster pixel belongs to a cell iff the pixel centre lies within the cell polygon (`rasterio.features.geometry_mask(..., all_touched=False)`). Applied identically to every raster, deterministic across repeated runs.

**NoData rule.** Valid pixels are in-cell pixels that are neither the raster's declared `nodata` value nor masked. `n_nodata` counts masked/NoData pixels AND in-cell positions falling outside the raster's data extent. NoData pixels are excluded from every statistic; `n_valid + n_nodata` equals the total clipped selection. A cell with zero valid pixels gets a null value for that variable.

**Dominant land use.** Land use is the mode (most frequent NLUM code) over the cell's valid pixels, mapped to its ALUM v8 tertiary class name. Tie-break: the lowest code wins (deterministic). A code absent from the ALUM class table is recorded as `unmapped:<code>`.

**Protected areas.** Overlap is a spatial intersection (shared interior OR boundary) computed in `EPSG:3577` (Australian Albers), never in `EPSG:4326` degrees. `protected_area` is the boolean overlap; `protected_area_name` is the `'; '`-joined set of distinct CAPAD names (unnamed features -> `(unnamed protected area)`).

## Coverage

Per source raster, the count of grid cells inside vs outside coverage. For every raster `inside + outside == total` (partition of the grid, Req 6.5).

| Raster | Cells inside | Cells outside | Total | Partition OK |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| elevation | 40744 | 6567 | 47311 | yes |
| nlum | 40751 | 6560 | 47311 | yes |
| slope | 47311 | 0 | 47311 | yes |
| tri | 100 | 47211 | 47311 | yes |

**Coverage.** For the statewide-coverage build the elevation, slope and NLUM rasters are the full-NSW SRTM GL3 / ABARES NLUM clips, so coverage is NSW-wide (the per-raster inside/outside counts above are the ground truth for this run). The TRI raster still covers only the tiny Glen-Innes sub-window by design: TRI is out of coverage for almost the entire grid and is therefore EXCLUDED from the confidence decision so it does not flag the whole grid low (Req 6.6). Cells whose centroid lies outside a raster's extent are out of coverage for that raster: their derived variable is null and (for the required rasters) the cell is flagged low confidence.

**Urban areas (`urban_area`).** Boolean per-cell overlap against the ABS UCL 2021 urban centres/localities, computed as a cell-centre intersection in `EPSG:3577` (the same join basis as the protected-area overlap). The single `sos_code_2021 == "13"` "Rural Balance" catch-all polygon is dropped before the join; Major Urban / Other Urban / Bounded Locality (codes 10/11/12) are kept. A missing urban source halts the run — `urban_area` is never defaulted to False for an absent extract.

**Land mask (`on_land`).** Boolean per-cell centroid-in-land test against the Natural Earth 1:50m land polygons (`ne_land-50m_australia.geojson`), computed in `EPSG:3577` (point-in-polygon on each cell's centroid). `on_land = False` marks offshore/marine cells so the exclusion stage can rule them out before ranking. The NE 1:50m mask is coarse (~5 km) and a few near-shore cells may be mis-classified; this is accepted at the 0.05-degree analysis resolution and is swappable for the ABS national boundary by one path constant.
